notes.title: Announcing the release date of our 2nd game, Vartio!
notes.notes:
[p][/p][previewyoutube="Vqr4IdFvSRw;full"][/previewyoutube][p]We are super excited to announce our 2nd game, Vartio's release date!

Experience the world of Kaamos from another perspective in this psychological horror game, where you patrol a dark forest when the world turned dark. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/e1ff56474bb8c9e2ed94a13e85c5ac0318d1281e.png"][/img]

[i]A short psychological horror experience from the creators of Kaamos.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][b]Vartio[/b] (Finnish for “Patrol”) drops you into the boots of a medieval guardsman assigned to a solitary night watch. Your duty: patrol the shadowy forests surrounding a remote watchtower and report back to your commander. But something is wrong out there. And it’s getting closer.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Patrol the darkness[/b][/h2][p]Step out into the cold woods under the cover of night. As a lone sentry on the empire’s edge, your torch is dim, and your instincts are all you can trust.[/p][h2][b]Paranoia made real[/b][/h2][p]Rely on your ears more than your eyes. Every rustle in the brush, every creak of a branch may spell danger. Are those footsteps? Or just the wind?[/p][h2][b]Something is watching[/b][/h2][p]The deeper into the forest you go, the more uncertain reality becomes. Blood trails. Whispers. Was that a raider—or something worse?[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/0f2bb5f0db1fe8201bd6897c9407a93fb6cf49f7.png"][/img][/p][h2][/h2][list][*][p]A compact, focused psychological horror experience (~20 minutes).[/p][/*][*][p]Immersive 3D pixel art with a dark retro aesthetic.[/p][/*][*][p]Rich atmospheric sound design crafted to heighten tension.[/p][/*][*][p]Standalone story set in the same unsettling world as [i]Kaamos[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
[h1]We're super excited to finally announce the release date for Kaamos[/h1]

[previewyoutube=StcZ_iqqE_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/4663431640f2827df39063157a7d6dc3c58ab210.png[/img]

Face hostile opponents in duels to the death where you see enemy actions in advance. Match tiles of the same color on a grid where dragging a row or column loops it back on the other side in order to counter the incoming onslaught of enemy attacks. Stab, crush and cleave your way to victory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/8afd531ddb145ead4e54f95bbeb63eee8a6b091f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/3e64a7d9df6a491a9f44777d5392befe00d597d3.png[/img]

Equip powerful weapons, armor, and rings to change your tactics and tile selection for battles. Want to be a dual-wielding berserker, an evasive duelist, or a knight clad in heavy armor? With over 180 items there are interesting build choices and playstyles for every player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/58e11a006f67ca67af5dd1a3c87659055493c416.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/e81dac77f95b5997c67e690f66d6fdc8b8a4c59c.png[/img]

Navigate a randomly generated dark medieval world filled with madness. Unravel the mystery behind the disappearance of the Sun or fade into the darkness. You are not alone. There’s always something lurking in the dark behind every fork in the path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45306150/e42a55db7c5c39d65d566d6d0484409f9ce8aa7b.gif[/img]
